name: friday-agent
description: Single-owner self-hosted AI agent control plane for private device infrastructure

scripts.build: npm run build -w @friday/protocol && npm run build -w @friday/fridayd && npm run build -w @friday/pi-worker && npm run build -w @friday/sandboxd && npm run build -w @friday/runner && npm run build -w @friday/channel-gateway && npm run build -w @friday/fridayctl
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm audit --audit-level=moderate && sh -n deploy/hub/install-hub.sh && sh -n deploy/hub/configure-telegram.sh && sh -n deploy/runner/install-managed-runner.sh && sh -n deploy/runner/upgrade-managed-runner.sh && sh -n deploy/sandboxd/install-managed-sandboxd.sh && bash scripts/public-release-check.sh
